query: What features can be extracted to train a model to predict a review's score?

per_column.name: overall_sentiment
per_column.rationale: Overall sentiment of the review text is essentially a paraphrase of the star rating; it is a near-deterministic proxy for the score derived from the same text, not an independent predictor. High risk of leakage/restatement.

per_column.name: expectation_match
per_column.rationale: Whether the product met/exceeded/fell below expectations is an evaluative judgment that maps almost directly onto the score (exceeded=high, below=low). It restates the outcome rather than predicting it.

per_column.name: taste_texture_quality
per_column.rationale: A positive/negative quality assessment extracted from the review is another sentiment restatement strongly co-determined with the score; effectively leakage.

per_column.name: product_effectiveness
per_column.rationale: 'works_as_claimed' vs 'does_not_work' is a valenced satisfaction judgment tightly coupled to the rating; it restates the outcome rather than offering exogenous signal.

per_column.name: description_accuracy
per_column.rationale: Accurate/inaccurate is an evaluative verdict extracted from the review that co-moves with satisfaction and score; leakage-prone restatement.

per_column.name: product_category
per_column.rationale: Product category is an exogenous attribute of the item, not derived from the reviewer's evaluation. Categories can carry mild baseline differences in rating distributions, giving genuine, non-leaking predictive signal.

per_column.name: health_dietary_mention
per_column.rationale: Whether the review mentions health/dietary topics is a topical/content feature not inherently valenced; it lies outside the outcome and may plausibly correlate weakly with score without restating it.

per_column.name: use_case_context
per_column.rationale: The usage context (personal, pet, cooking, gifting) is a descriptive, non-evaluative attribute independent of the rating; a legitimate if modest predictor.

per_column.name: review_specificity
per_column.rationale: Specificity/detail of the review is a stylistic property largely orthogonal to valence; it may carry weak predictive signal (e.g., detail vs. rating extremity) without restating the score.

per_column.name: comparison_to_alternative
per_column.rationale: Whether the reviewer compares to alternatives is a structural/content feature that is not inherently valenced and lies outside the outcome; a legitimate, if weak, predictor.

judge.rationale: Half of the added columns (overall_sentiment, expectation_match, taste_texture_quality, product_effectiveness, description_accuracy) are evaluative judgments extracted from the same review text and are near-deterministic restatements of the score, constituting leakage rather than genuine predictors. The remaining five (product_category, health_dietary_mention, use_case_context, review_specificity, comparison_to_alternative) are descriptive/topical/structural attributes that lie outside the outcome and offer legitimate but generally weak predictive signal. As a set, the leakage-free predictors provide modest incremental leverage over the original columns, so overall genuine predictive utility is limited.
